name: Shop
description: Variants, prices in several currencies, stock, minimum order quantities and a cart for a Mallok site.

buffer_rate.label: Exchange buffer
buffer_rate.help: Added on top of the exchange rate when a price is converted, to absorb rate movement and cross-border payment fees. 0.03 is 3%.

recalc_threshold.label: Repricing threshold
recalc_threshold.help: A converted price is recomputed only once the rate has drifted this far from the rate it was computed at. 0.02 is 2%.

rounding.label: Price rounding
rounding.help: How a converted price is rounded up to a price point: to the next .99, or to the next whole unit.
